questions.question: Sattriya is a classical dance form that originated in which Indian state?
Which of the following was one of the key features of the Government of India Act, 1935?
options: Establishment and training of the Indian National Army
Abolition of British monarchy in India
Criminalisation of the Sati practice and its regulation
Provincial autonomy and proposal for a federal structure
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Provincial autonomy and proposal for a federal structure) है।

questions.question: Under Article 15(2), no citizen shall be denied access to public places on the grounds of ______.
options: religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth) है।

questions.question: Praveen Sood, who received a one-year extension in his tenure in May 2025, is the director of which organisation?

What type of energy does a physics textbook have when held in the air before it is dropped?
In January 2025, the Chief Minister of which state launched 'KaWaCHaM', one of the world’s fastest weather alert systems?
The members of the Rajya Sabha representing the states are elected by ______.
options: elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies) है।

questions.question: In March 2025, who announced the news of Chandraayan-5 receiving Central government’s approval?

India lags in how many of the 16 SDGs, as per the 'State of States: Are We on Track to Achieve Sustainable Development Goals 2030' report released by the Centre for Science and Environment in February 2025?
Which of the following correctly describes the Peninsular Plateau of India?
options: A narrow strip of land along the eastern coastline
A marshy plain between two major Indian rivers
A triangular plateau covering nearly half of India
An island group formed by coral deposits in the sea
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (A triangular plateau covering nearly half of India) है।

questions.question: Who secured the Asian Snooker Championship 2025 men's title by defeating Amir Sarkosh of Iran in the final?
In which year was the English East India Company granted a Royal Charter by Queen Elizabeth?
What is a notable characteristic of the Eastern Coastal Plains in terms of port development?
options: They are formed by volcanic activity.
They provide natural conditions for ports.
They are ideal for natural harbours.
They are emergent coastlines, hence not ideal for natural ports.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (They are emergent coastlines, hence not ideal for natural ports.) है।
